slides.title: How could this Friday get any better?
slides.body: 4:58 PM. Laptop half closed. Weekend loading.

slides.title: Oh. The client needs a current COI before Monday.
The one in the shared drive expired in August.
The insurance agent's office closed at 4.
And the person who renewed it last year left in March.
Next time, find out before it expires.
slides.body: CertTrack tracks your licenses, permits and insurance policies and alerts you before they expire.
